pages.text: A vanilla farm-mode maid $(bold)ignores the seasons$(): she happily plants wheat in the middle of winter. Out-of-season crops in this mod wither at settlement with $(thing)witherChance$() (1.0 = always), so every seed she plants - and every bone meal she feeds it - is burned for nothing.$(br2)With the companion on, she $(bold)stops sowing out of season$(): the seeds stay in her backpack until the season fits, and she will not fertilize an out-of-season crop either.

pages.title: How Far This Reaches
pages.text: The check only covers crops $(bold)this mod manages$() (crops, stems, nether wart, cocoa, sweet berry bush and their subclasses); other mods' crops planted on vanilla farmland keep their original rules.$(br2)It reads the same source your tooltips do: Serene Seasons' fertility, including whatever you added in $(thing)seedSeasons$() (merged as a union with datapack tags).$(br2)Want her old behaviour back? Turn $(thing)enableMaidCompat$() off - she immediately returns to planting blind to the season.
